rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for favouring progress or being politically progressive.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 hou2 zeon3 bou6

rows.note: Use this when progressive means advanced or technologically developed, rather than for political progressivism.

example.english: The technology in this computer is very progressive.
example.traditional: 呢部電腦嘅技術好先進。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 gei6 seot6 hou2 sin1 zeon3

rows.note: Use this for a liberal or open-minded person, attitude, or policy.

example.english: My dad is quite progressive and will not force me to study traditional subjects.
example.traditional: 我阿爸幾開明，唔會逼我讀傳統科目。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 gei2 hoi1 ming4 m4 wui5 bik1 ngo5 duk6 cyun4 tung2 fo1 muk6

rows.note: Use this construction when something is gradually becoming more or increasingly ADJ.

example.english: This city's development is becoming more progressive.
example.traditional: 呢個城市嘅發展越嚟越先進。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 faat3 zin2 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 sin1 zeon3
